scope: the exact twelve-state, five-J-edge-orbit C^6 completion of claim 1529 restricted to the maximal anomaly-free central U(1)^2 exhibited in claim 1532

compatibilityDecision.perturbativeAnomalyCancellation: SAT: bosonic link fields do not change the chiral fermion anomaly tensor

compatibilityDecision.massGapOnExactTwelveStateSupport: UNSAT: each six-state connected component has chiral bipartition sizes 4 and 2, so every grading-odd Dirac operator on this support has nullity at least two per component and at least four total
compatibilityDecision.physicalScalarCompletion: UNDERDETERMINED: no scalar potential, kinetic normalization, vacuum alignment, Yukawa identification or physical Pati-Salam representation is supplied

minimalReopeningDatum: specify relation-even dynamical link/scalar fields carrying the three primitive charge types, their independent edge Yukawa maps and a potential with the required nonzero VEVs; obtaining a mass gap additionally requires new grading-odd support or multiplicity that removes the 4-versus-2 component imbalance, plus a correspondence to the N--Z--X physical coefficient texture
boundary: This is an exact charge, lattice and support audit for the label-level anomaly-free U(1)^2. It neither derives the link fields from a spectral action nor supplies a physical Higgs sector.
